children: Shares of Gland Pharma gave up opening gains on Friday, September 4, and trade with losses, after a large transaction that took place in the stock.
As many as 75 lakh shares or 4.5% equity of Gland Pharma changed hands in a block deal window on Friday, September 4.
While the average price at which the shares changed hands is not yet known, it could be around ₹2,800 per share. Based on this, the total transaction value comes up to around ₹2,100 crore.
While promoter entity Focus Pharma is the likely seller in this transaction, the official buyers are not known.

On Thursday, CNBC-TV18 reported, citing sources that Fosun Pharma was likely to sell up to 5% of its stake in the company for ₹2,279.5 crore. The floor price had been set at ₹2,763 per share, sources said.
At the end of the June quarter, promoter Fosun Pharma Industrial Pte Ltd held 51.77% stake in Gland Pharma while public shareholders held 48.23% stake, as per data available on the stock exchanges.

On another note, earlier this week, Gland Pharma informed the exchanges that US drug regulator had concluded its routine good manufacturing practice (GMP) inspection at the company's VSEZ sterile oncology formulations facility and API facility with zero Form 483 observations. The US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) had conducted the inspection between August 24, 2026 and September 1, 2026.

Gland Pharma reported its first quarter earnings last month. Its net profit increased 47.1% to ₹317 crore from ₹215 crore last year. Its revenue was up 19.6% at ₹1,800.2 crore from ₹1,505.6 crore last year.

The company's earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) increased 33.1% to ₹489.2 crore from ₹367.6 crore last year. Its margin expanded to 27.2% from 24.4% in the year-ago period.
Shares of Gland Pharma are trading 1% lower on Friday at ₹2,878.9. The stock has risen 11.5% in the last month, taking its year-to-date advance higher to 65%.

title: Gland Pharma shares fall after ₹2,100 crore block deal; Promoter likely seller
